mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that improves corporate revenue outlooks, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising HOUST and RSAFS, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) increase borrowing costs and dampen economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals strong manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% indicates economic slowdown that reduces earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods with GDPC1 < 1.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth and unemployment decline signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing demand regimes (HOUST > 1200) signal strong consumer confidence that drives economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods with HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
